services.name: Tickets
services.desc: Our Stampede Ticket office is staffed by committed volunteers happy to help you find your perfect spot to enjoy all of the rodeo action at the Williams Lake Stampede. The office is located behind our Grandstand at the Stampede Grounds. Office hours are Monday Friday 9am-5pm. Saturday 10am-4pm Tickets can be purchased at the Grandstand office and through Showpass our only online platform TICKETS.Be aware of 3rd party sellers online reselling tickets for much higher costs. All seating in our Grandstand is general seating and not assigned.** Prices subject to taxes, which will be calculated at time or

services.desc: Our pens are available to those that are traveling through and need to give your animals a rest on their journey. Some pens have stock tanks or automatic waterers while others will require you to provide buckets. Water is only available from April to October.
